description: BitTuitive pays a scoreboard-verified L402 API and returns its data plus routing metadata — use this when the data you need is on another paid API. Price: upstream price + routing fee (max(20%, 3 sats)); the 402 body shows the all-in amount. Sample (illustrative, not live): {"data":{"note":"The upstream API's JSON body is returned here unchanged."},"routing":{"routed_by":"BitTuitive L402 router","upstream":{"endpoint_id":"example-id","name":"Example L402 API","host":"example.com","data_type":"bitcoin","score":92},"paid_sats":15,"upstream_price_sats":10,"fee_sats":5,"fallback_used":false}} Pay: Call it, get HTTP 402 (or MCP payment_required) with a Lightning invoice and macaroon, pay the invoice, then retry with `Authorization: L402 <macaroon>:<preimage>`. Or pay the same all-in price in USDC on Base via x402 (see `price_usd`, `price_breakdown_usd` and `accepts`; routing fee included): sign accepts[0] with an x402 client and call route_call again with the SAME arguments plus the PaymentPayload in params._meta['x402/payment'] (or the base64 x402_payment argument). A routed call pays an upstream API, so your USDC is settled first; if every upstream fails you get a single-use credit token (pass it as `credit`). Give endpoint_id (from route_endpoints) OR data_type and/or q (best pick, with fallback). If status is 'running', repeat the same call with the same l402_credential, credit or x402_payment.

credit.description: Credit token from a failed routed call (instead of paying).

l402_credential.description: Optional L402 credential '<macaroon>:<preimage_hex>' (or 'L402 <macaroon>:<preimage>') from a paid invoice or an active subscription. Omit it to receive the Lightning invoice and macaroon.

params.description: Optional query parameters forwarded to the upstream API.

q.description: Keywords for best-pick mode, e.g. 'air quality'.

x402_payment.description: Optional x402 payment (USDC on Base): base64 PaymentPayload (v2, or v1 X-PAYMENT format) signed for accepts[0] of this tool's payment_required result. Alternative to params._meta['x402/payment']. Omit both to receive the payment requirements.

name: route_call
title: Call any verified data API through BitTuitive (paid: L402 sats or x402 USDC)
